cosmo_z0.notes: Cosmology z=0: Sens is |allowed_m_set| under omega_vis0±sigma (stable=True).
cosmo_z0.tie_break: prefer smaller m inside the discrete stability set; fallback to best mismatch

gamma_direct.notes: Gamma-direct: Sens is kernel-family spread of the inverse-variance joint gamma_hat over a fixed rational t-grid.
gamma_direct.tie_break: J, then t-complexity, then n, then m

mu_Z.notes: EW: Sens is kernel-family spread of (e_alpha+e_sin2) over a fixed rational t-grid at each m.
mu_Z.tie_break: J, then t-complexity, then n, then m
